Hints: One radian is when the arc equals the radius.;Divide arc length by radius.
Solution: Radian measure is the dimensionless ratio theta=s/r, arc length divided by the positive radius. Rearranging gives s=r*theta; use the same units for the two lengths.

Question Choices: An arc is 1/8 of a circumference. Find its central angle in radians.
Hints: A full circle is 2pi radians.;Divide 2pi by 8.
Solution: A full turn is 2pi radians. The arc and central angle occupy the same fraction 1/8, so theta=(1/8)*2pi=1/4pi radians.
